title: finding(plugin-form,fields): the line-items family's remaining chrome is English under zh-CN: LineItemsPanel's states and errors, GridField's Total / Columns / row-action labels, and MasterDetailForm's `Line Items` section heading
body:
Filing-gate category: ① class (a), the family close-out card for the line-items chrome. `reach:` a public door, measured. The objectui#11131 dev ran an uncommitted zh render probe at PR objectui#11143's head `370aaf443`, with 3 of 3 assertions holding on the wrong answer:
- a `record:line_items` panel with no `parentId` shows `Save the record first to add line items.` in English;
- one with a `totalField` shows the grid footer `Total` in English;
- `MasterDetailForm` with a detail entry that authors no `title` renders the section heading `Line Items` in English.

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11143 (objectui#11131), from the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings[0]` and `[1]`. That PR's contract review (`5898608986`, ③) confirmed every site real at the head and judged that the two belong in ONE family remainder card. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

This is the family of objectui#10999 → #11039 → #11071 → #11131, so it uses that pattern:
- `LineItemsPanel` extends its own `useLineItemsTranslation` table, which PR objectui#11143 started;
- `GridField` uses `useFieldTranslation` with inline defaults gated by `check:i18n-keys`;
- `MasterDetailForm` reuses PR objectui#11143's `form.lineItems.title` through a `useFormChromeTranslation` row;
- existing keys (for example `common.loading`) are reused where the meaning is the same, and new keys go in all ten packs only where none exists;
- an authored label still wins.

The row-action pairs disagree with each other (`Open row` vs `Open full form`, `Duplicate row` vs `Duplicate line`), so choosing their keys is part of the card; one meaning should get one key.

Optional alignment (review ③ 3, no rendered reach today): the list-mode empty text's hole defaults to `detail.add` while the button defaults to `Add line`.

Serial: `MasterDetailForm.tsx` is on PR objectui#11142 (objectui#11132), and `LineItemsPanel.tsx`, `GridField.tsx` and the packs are on PR objectui#11143. Dispatch after both merge.

## Dedupe

The 1168 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2231), were grepped:
- `Save the record first to add line items`: 2 hits. One is PR objectui#11143 (the source). The other is PR objectui#10751 (closed), a fix to which parent's lines the panel draws, not to its language.
- `Optional columns`, `Duplicate line` and `MasterDetailForm … Line Items`: 1 hit each, PR objectui#11143.
- `Drag to reorder`: 0 hits.
